readerCopy.body: Some of the most important changes happen quietly when you stop organizing your life around a restriction you no longer need. When Uranus trines Pluto, deeper change can settle into the systems, habits, and decisions that shape how much autonomy you actually have, often without requiring a dramatic confrontation first. Look for the arrangement that gives you more control over your time, access, money, or choices while still functioning well enough to rely on. A real shift in power may feel surprisingly ordinary once your daily life stops revolving around the old limitation.
